title: Sindh Companies Profits Workers Participation Amendment Act 2017

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Companies Profits Workers Participation Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXIII OF 2017
ACT
XXIII OF 2017
SINDH
COMPANIES PROFITS (WORKERS PARTICIPATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act to amend the Sindh
Companies Profits (Workers Participation) Act, 2015
[Gazette
of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 18th July, 2017]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-20/2017, dated 18.7.2017.---The Sindh Companies Profits (Workers Participation) (Amendment)
Bill, 2017 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 3rd July, 2017 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 12th July, 2017 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS
it is expedient to amend the Sindh Companies Profits
(Workers Participation) Act, 2015, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Sindh Companies Profits
(Workers Participation) (Amendment) Act, 2017.
(2) It
shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and
from 1st day of July, 2011.
